title: KPI Illumination: Launch Readiness & Contingency Grid
body:
Table:
Release Phase | Milestone | Owner | KPI Target (7d) | Current Value | Risk Level | Prelaunch Checks | Contingency Action | Escalation Owner | Est. Cost Impact
Canary | Canary-1 traffic probe (internal) | Dana Kim | p99 latency < 350ms; error rate < 0.5% | p99 320ms; err 0.3% | Low | smoke tests, token-cost sanity, model-variant fallback validated | Pause external traffic, roll back to pinned model-v1.2 | Evan Brooks | $0
Staged Ramp | Beta customers onboarded (10 accounts) | Priya Reddy | 99% success rate; avg latency < 400ms | success 96%; avg 410ms | Medium | capacity reservation confirmed, autoscale policy load test | Increase dedicated pool, enable burst nodes, tighten batching | Aisha Patel | $1,200/day
Open Launch | Regional routing in production | Aisha Patel | sustain 500 qps; cost per 1k tokens <$0.18 | 430 qps; $0.21 | High | canary lessons applied, canary rollback window closed, monitoring alerts primed | Throttle traffic, shift to cheaper model-quantized variant, enable cache prefixing | SRE on-call (pager) | $6,500/day
Emergency Surge | Unexpected 3x traffic | SRE team | degrade gracefully; error < 3% | n/a | Critical | surge limiters configured, fallbacks tested | Traffic shaping, queueing, surge pricing opt-in, degrade non-essential features | Head of Prod Ops | $15,000/day

Notes & Interpretation:
- 'KPI Target' shows operational SLOs to validate pre-launch. 'Current Value' should be updated daily during ramp and hourly during launch.
- 'Risk Level' is product-ops qualitative assessment (Low/Medium/High/Critical). Use this column to trigger escalation thresholds in the 'Contingency Action'.
- Est. Cost Impact is a rough run-rate at the indicated traffic/mitigation approach; finance must sign off on >$5k/day interventions.

Quick-read Checklists (for on-call and PMs):
- Pre-72h: finalize canary test plan, reserve Dedicated pools, run end-to-end smoke with production configs.
- Pre-24h: confirm rollout window, communications, customer opt-in list, and rollback strategy.
- T-0 Launch: enable tracing hooks, toggle verbose logging for first 30m, make sure rollback script is in hand.

Signal thresholds that require immediate action:
- p99 latency exceeds target by >15% for 10m -> Alert SRE, consider rollout pause.
- Errors surge >1% absolute increase over baseline for 5m -> Invoke contingency action.
- Cost per 1k tokens rises >25% vs expected -> Evaluate quantized model or reduce qps.

Triage ladder (owner assignment):
- First responder: on-call SRE (investigate infra, autoscaling).
- Secondary: product-ops lead (assess user impact, coordinate rollout pause).
- Tertiary: engineering on-call for fixes and model-variant rollbacks.

Post-launch 72h readout fields to capture (add to sheet daily):
- Traffic by region, average latency, p50/p95/p99, error breakdown (5xx, 4xx, model-quality), top 3 customer-reported issues, cost delta vs forecast, actions taken.

Open questions for leadership:
- Approve $15k/day surge buffer for first 7 days of open launch? (needs SLT approval)
- Do we require customer-specific SLA addenda for early enterprise adopters?

Linked quick actions (copy to ops channel):
- '/run rollback pinned-model v1.2'
- '/scale pool dedicated-prod +4'
- '/mute alert LATENCY-P99 if investigating'
